does: Answers whether the caller must wait before the next frame: due time = (frames since the clock base) * FrameRateDiv * 1000 / FrameRate * the 16.16 speed scale at *(HBINK+0x1B8)+0x4C, against RADTimerRead minus the start time HBINK+0x644; reads FrameRate and the scale at every call; with no Bink sound track (HBINK+0x12C = 0) a late clip is never waited for and the clock is re-based when more than twice HBINK+0x64C ms late

evidence.says: live, a 5 s clip (150 frames, 30/1 fps) replayed in the menu: FrameRate written to 10 after open -> 14.99 s; speed scale written 0x20000 -> 10.0 s; unpatched 5.46 s
